title: Is US healthcare still using racist medical practices?

title: Richest Colombians Face Hefty Tax Hikes on Wealth and Income
summary: Colombia’s richest citizens face a tripling in the top rate of wealth tax, as well as higher levies on salaries and luxury goods, as the leftist government of Gustavo Petro taps them to narrow the widest fiscal deficit since the pandemic.
